bodies: American Association of Electronic Reporters and Transcribers
American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
NALS, the association for legal professionals
Committee on Bar Admissions (Louisiana Supreme Court)
New York State Board of Law Examiners
Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics
United States Patent and Trademark Office

exams.name: AAERT Certified Deposition Reporter
exams.body: American Association of Electronic Reporters and Transcribers
exams.blurb: A certification for professionals who record and transcribe depositions using digital or stenographic methods in legal discovery settings.

exams.name: AAERT Certified Electronic Recorder
exams.body: American Association of Electronic Reporters and Transcribers
exams.blurb: A certification for digital recording monitors who operate audio equipment and manage the electronic capture of legal proceedings.

exams.name: AAERT Certified Electronic Transcriber
exams.body: American Association of Electronic Reporters and Transcribers
exams.blurb: A credential for transcribers who convert digitally recorded proceedings into certified written transcripts meeting court reporting standards.

exams.name: AHDI Certified Healthcare Documentation Specialist
exams.blurb: An advanced medical documentation credential requiring the RHDS plus experience and demonstrating expertise across complex healthcare specialties.

exams.name: AHDI Registered Healthcare Documentation Specialist
exams.blurb: An entry-level credential for medical transcriptionists who convert provider dictation into accurate healthcare documentation from home or clinic.

exams.name: Certified Scopist
exams.blurb: A professional who edits and proofreads the untranslated notes of court reporters, requiring training in reporting software and legal terminology.

exams.name: NCRA Certified Broadcast Captioner
exams.blurb: A certification for captioners who provide live broadcast captions for television and web programming under strict accuracy and speed standards.

exams.name: NCRA Certified CART Provider
exams.blurb: A credential for reporters delivering Communication Access Realtime Translation services in classrooms, meetings and public accommodations.

exams.name: NCRA Certified Legal Video Specialist
exams.blurb: A certification for court reporters who record, log and produce synchronized legal videography for depositions and courtroom proceedings.

exams.name: NCRA Certified Media Realtime Specialist
exams.blurb: An advanced NCRA credential for captioners specializing in fast-paced media and sports broadcast realtime transcription environments.

exams.name: NCRA Certified Realtime Captioner
exams.blurb: A credential for providers who deliverCommunication Access Realtime Translation (CART) captioning for deaf and hard-of-hearing audiences.

exams.name: NCRA Certified Realtime Instructor
exams.blurb: A certification for experienced reporters who teach realtime theory and technology to students in court reporting and captioning programs.

exams.name: NCRA Certified Realtime Reporter
exams.blurb: A certification demonstrating the ability to produce accurate, instantaneous realtime translation of proceedings for live display and accessibility.

exams.name: NCRA Registered Diplomate Reporter
exams.blurb: NCRA’s highest reporter credential requiring the RMR plus a demanding realtime skills test and an advanced written knowledge examination.

exams.name: NCRA Registered Merit Reporter
exams.blurb: An advanced NCRA certification for reporters who have held the RPR and pass a higher-speed skills test and merit-level written examination.

exams.name: NCRA Registered Professional Reporter
exams.blurb: The entry-level NCRA certification requiring a skills test and written exam that validates realtime and traditional stenographic court reporting.

exams.name: NCRA Registered Skilled Reporter
exams.blurb: A skills-based NCRA certificate validating proficiency in capturing the spoken record for government and educational reporting settings.

exams.name: NVRA Certified Monitor
exams.blurb: A credential for voice writers who monitor and verify realtime voice translation output for accuracy during official reporting assignments.

exams.name: NVRA Certified Voice Reporter
exams.blurb: A certification for voice writers who use mask-and-voice methodology to create the official record of courts and other proceedings.

exams.name: AAPI Accredited Legal Professional
exams.blurb: A specialized accreditation for legal support professionals emphasizing compliance, document management and procedures within legal operations.

exams.name: Certified E-Discovery Specialist
exams.blurb: A credential validating expertise in the legal hold, collection, processing and review of electronically stored information in litigation.

exams.name: Certified Legal Investigator
exams.blurb: An advanced credential for professional investigators demonstrating proficiency in evidence gathering, surveillance and courtroom testimony.

exams.name: Certified Legal Manager
exams.blurb: A credential for law firm and legal department administrators covering finance, human resources, operations and legal industry ethics.

exams.name: Certified Legal Nurse Consultant
exams.body: American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
exams.blurb: A certification for registered nurses who analyze medical records and provide expert consultation on healthcare-related legal cases.

exams.name: Certified Notary Signing Agent
exams.blurb: A Notary Public certification specializing in properly executing and witnessing mortgage and real estate loan document signings.

exams.name: NALA Advanced Paralegal Certification
exams.blurb: A post-certification program offering concentrated specialty certificates in subjects such as bankruptcy, discovery and intellectual property.

exams.name: NALA Certified Paralegal
exams.blurb: NALA’s flagship credential earned by passing a two-day exam covering federal law, procedural knowledge and an area of practice specialty.

exams.name: NALS Accredited Legal Professional
exams.body: NALS, the association for legal professionals
exams.blurb: A foundational credential testing knowledge of legal terminology, procedures and office skills for legal support staff and entry-level paralegals.

exams.name: NALS Accredited Legal Secretary
exams.body: NALS, the association for legal professionals
exams.blurb: A NALS credential for legal secretaries covering office technology, transcription, filing and legal terminology within a law office environment.

exams.name: NALS Certified Legal Professional
exams.body: NALS, the association for legal professionals
exams.blurb: A NALS certification building on the ALP that validates advanced legal knowledge; exam availability has alternated with the PP offering over time.

exams.name: NALS Professional Legal Secretary
exams.body: NALS, the association for legal professionals
exams.blurb: A legacy NALS designation for experienced legal secretaries that has largely been consolidated into the ALP and CLP credential framework.

exams.name: NALS Professional Paralegal
exams.body: NALS, the association for legal professionals
exams.blurb: An advanced NALS credential examining substantive law and paralegal ethics; the exam pathway has been periodically paused between testing cycles.

exams.name: NFPA Paralegal Advanced Competency Exam
exams.blurb: A two-tier exam leading to the Registered Paralegal (RP) designation for experienced paralegals demonstrating advanced competency and ethics.

exams.name: NFPA Paralegal CORE Competency Exam
exams.blurb: An entry-level exam granting the Certified Paralegal (CRP) designation for candidates with less than two years of substantive paralegal experience.

exams.name: California Bar Exam
exams.blurb: California’s jurisdiction-specific two-day bar exam combining state essays, performance tests and the Multistate Bar Examination for state licensure.

exams.name: Louisiana Bar Exam
exams.body: Committee on Bar Admissions (Louisiana Supreme Court)
exams.blurb: Louisiana’s civil-law jurisdiction exam using state-written essays and multiple-choice questions rather than the MBE for admission to practice.

exams.name: Multistate Bar Examination
exams.blurb: A six-hour, 200-question multiple-choice test covering constitutional law, contracts, criminal law, evidence, property and torts administered as part of the UBE.

exams.name: Multistate Essay Examination
exams.blurb: A three-hour essay test of six questions assessing the ability to analyze legal issues across common law and statutory subjects within the Uniform Bar Exam.

exams.name: Multistate Performance Test
exams.blurb: A three-hour skills test using two file-and-library tasks that evaluates practical lawyering abilities such as drafting and legal analysis under time pressure.

exams.name: Multistate Professional Responsibility Examination
exams.blurb: A two-hour, 60-question multiple-choice exam on legal ethics and professional conduct required for admission to the bar in most U.S. jurisdictions.

exams.name: New York Law Course
exams.body: New York State Board of Law Examiners
exams.blurb: A free online course of approximately 15 hours covering New York practice and procedure that candidates must complete before taking the NYLE.

exams.name: New York Law Exam
exams.body: New York State Board of Law Examiners
exams.blurb: A 50-question open-book multiple-choice test of New York-specific law that candidates must pass in addition to the UBE for New York bar admission.

exams.name: NextGen Bar Exam
exams.blurb: The NCBE’s restructured bar exam launching in July 2026, replacing the traditional UBE with integrated skills and knowledge tasks across core legal subjects.

exams.name: Uniform Bar Exam
exams.blurb: A portable two-day bar exam composed of the MBE, MEE and MPT that participating jurisdictions use and score on a common 400-point scale.

exams.name: Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional
exams.body: Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics
exams.blurb: A credential for compliance officers covering program design, risk assessment, investigation and ethics within organizational compliance functions.

exams.name: Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional - International
exams.body: Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics
exams.blurb: An international variant of the CCEP focusing on anti-corruption, cross-border regulations and multinational compliance program requirements.

exams.name: Certified Government Financial Manager
exams.blurb: A credential for public-sector financial professionals covering governmental accounting, auditing and financial reporting and control standards.

exams.name: Certified HIPAA Professional
exams.blurb: A certification demonstrating working knowledge of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act privacy and security rule requirements.

exams.name: Certified in Healthcare Compliance
exams.blurb: A credential for healthcare compliance professionals addressing fraud, waste, abuse, privacy and regulatory requirements across provider settings.

exams.name: Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance
exams.blurb: A specialization validating expertise in HIPAA, state privacy laws and the management of protected health information in healthcare organizations.

exams.name: Certified in Healthcare Research Compliance
exams.blurb: A credential covering compliance with human-subjects research rules, IRB oversight, clinical trial regulations and federal research funding requirements.

exams.name: Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager
exams.blurb: A banking credential for compliance managers demonstrating knowledge of consumer regulations, risk management and examination readiness.

exams.name: Certified Licensing Professional
exams.blurb: A credential for professionals who negotiate and manage intellectual property licenses, covering valuation, deal structuring and IP strategy.

exams.name: Certified Patent Valuation Analyst
exams.blurb: A specialization certifying expertise in quantifying the financial value of patent portfolios for transactions, licensing and litigation support.

exams.name: Patent Agent Qualification
exams.body: United States Patent and Trademark Office
exams.blurb: A registration distinction: patent agents pass the USPTO exam and prosecute patents, while patent attorneys additionally hold a law degree and bar license.

exams.name: USPTO Design Patent Practitioner Examination
exams.body: United States Patent and Trademark Office
exams.blurb: A specialized exam introduced in 2024 allowing qualified designers to practice before the USPTO solely in design patent matters.

exams.name: USPTO Registration Examination
exams.body: United States Patent and Trademark Office
exams.blurb: A 100-question multiple-choice exam on patent law and procedure that science and engineering graduates must pass to register as patent practitioners.
